module: Photo mode "scene" tab: reads and modifies the level's environment (time of day, date, clouds, fog, wind, north offset, celestial displays and meteors) via core_environment and core_celestial. It also handles saving/restoring the original state when the session opens/closes, an environment bookmark, and "scene" type presets (which include an advancedRender part handled by ui_photomode_advancedRender).
notes: Limits applied: time 0..1 (fraction of the day), cloudCover 0..3, fogDensity 0..50, fogAtmosphereHeight 1..1000. northOverride is brought into [-180, 180[ (180 kept if the input value is positive).

setSceneState requires an active photo session. __lerpSeconds (number) in the patch gives the transition duration passed to core_environment.setState. Only time, cloudCover, fogDensity, fogAtmosphereHeight and northOverride are taken into account by setSceneState (not windSpeed, winds or celestial).

Possible failure reasons: session_inactive, scene_state_invalid, scene_api_unavailable, scene_tod_unavailable, scene_celestial_api_unavailable, scene_set_failed, scene_patch_empty, scene_state_unavailable, bookmark_unavailable, preset_part_invalid.
applyPresetState accepts options.part: "all" (or nil), "environment" (time and date), "shadows", "detailTerrain", "weather", "celestial"; any other value gives preset_part_invalid.

Game bug: logSceneTimeOfDayDebug reads a variable isDebugEnabled that is not declared in this file (global, hence nil): the detailed time-of-day log is never written. Likewise logTag is not declared in this file and the log("E", logTag, ...) calls use a nil global.
formatSceneTimeOfDayDebugState displays sceneState.dayLength, a field absent from the scene state (displays nil).

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before: ui_photomode_shared, ui_photomode_advancedRender, core_celestial.

setSceneState.desc: Applies a partial scene patch (time, weather, north) during a photo session and returns the new state. Fails with scene_patch_empty if nothing was applied.

partialState.desc: Possible fields: time (0..1), play (boolean, with time), year, month, day, cloudCover, fogDensity, fogAtmosphereHeight, northOverride (degrees), __lerpSeconds (transition seconds).

getSceneState.desc: Returns the current scene state (buildState) with ok = session active; reason="session_inactive" otherwise.

returns.desc: Scene state: sessionActive, bookmarkAvailable, availability, time, play, year, month, day, cloudCover, fogDensity, fogAtmosphereHeight, windSpeed, cloudWindDirection, groundWind, northOverride, celestial, plus ok/reason.

buildState.desc: Builds the current scene state (values clamped to the limits) from core_environment and core_celestial, with the availability table indicating which elements are readable.

saveEnvironmentBookmark.desc: Stores the current environment state in S.savedEnvironmentBookmark. Requires an active session.

loadEnvironmentBookmark.desc: Reapplies the stored environment bookmark (time, weather, north, celestial elements). Requires an active session and a bookmark.

captureRestoreState.desc: Stores the original scene state in S.sessionSceneRestoreState to restore it at the end of the session. Called at the start of the photo session.

restoreState.desc: Restores the scene state saved by captureRestoreState (time, environment, north, celestial elements) then clears it. Called at the end of the photo session; does nothing if there is nothing to restore.

captureSerializableState.desc: Reads the raw scene state: time, play, year, month, day, cloudCover, fogDensity, fogAtmosphereHeight, windSpeed, cloudWindDirection, groundWind ({x,y,z} vectors), northOverride, celestial ({meteor, display}). Unavailable values are nil.

logTimeOfDayDebug.desc: Logs (debug level) the time of day as {time, play, dayLength} with a label. See the note on the isDebugEnabled bug.

capturePresetState.desc: Captures the current state as a preset: {scene={...}, advancedRender=...} (advancedRender comes from ui_photomode_advancedRender.buildMetadataState).

captureDefaultPresetState.desc: Captures the session's default state (restored or current scene state + default advanced render). Returns nil if neither is available.

applyPresetState.desc: Applies a scene preset (time, weather, north, celestial elements) then its advancedRender part. Stops at the first failure.

options.desc: options.part: all, environment, shadows, detailTerrain, weather, celestial.

buildMetadataState.desc: Returns the scene part to include in a capture's metadata: time, play, year, month, day, cloudCover, fogDensity, fogAtmosphereHeight, windSpeed, cloudWindDirection, groundWind, northOverride, celestial.
